geometry_provenance.parking_spaces: All 1,315 estimated space centers across groups 01-30 rotated approximately 90 degrees counterclockwise, scaled and translated together to the satellite image. Includes side modules O/P/Q. User reviewed the complete overlay on 2026-10-27. Individual painted stalls and restrictions have not been field verified.
geometry_provenance.landmarks: Manually selected approximate positions in Google Maps satellite view on 2026-10-27; not field verified.
geometry_provenance.distance_method: Euclidean straight-line in local meters; not routed walking or driving distance.
geometry_provenance.projection: x=(lon-ref_lon)*111000*cos(ref_lat); y=(lat-ref_lat)*111000; x east, y north. Matches legacy slot approximation.
geometry_provenance.access_assumptions: Both driveways support entry and exit; no directional lane geometry is modeled.
geometry_provenance.confirmed_landmarks: Two store doors and two bidirectional vehicle access points confirmed by user; coordinates unchanged during slot realignment.
geometry_provenance.legacy_geometry: Each slot retains its pre-alignment coordinates in legacy_geometry.
geometry_provenance.distance_fields: Four explicit distances per space: distance_to_exit_a_m, distance_to_exit_b_m, distance_to_door_1_m, distance_to_door_2_m. Straight-line estimates from aligned coordinates, not measured or aisle-routed distances.
